_comment: What the teacher checks once a sentence is read (services/syntax/teacher.py). Each check has an on/off switch and the reason shown to the reader when it fires: 'ar' is the book's wording, 'en' the plain one. A word a check flags loses its name and is drawn as a gap, because a dash is better than a confident wrong name. Switch a check off here and rescore with backend/scripts/score_iraab.py.

case_of_role._comment: The case each role takes (u = raf', a = nasb, i = jarr). A vowel the reader typed that says otherwise contradicts the role. The called noun (منادى) takes nasb only when it is the first word of an idafa.

one_subject.en: One verb has only one doer, and two words claim that job here.

passive_has_no_doer.ar: الفعل مبني للمجهول ولا فاعل له
passive_has_no_doer.en: The verb is typed as passive, so it has no doer; its noun stands in for the doer.

typed_case_fits_role.ar: الحركة المكتوبة لا تناسب هذا الإعراب
typed_case_fits_role.en: The vowel typed on this word does not fit the job it was given.

khabar_needs_mubtada.en: A خبر needs a مبتدأ, and none was found.

ism_inna_needs_inna.ar: اسم إن يحتاج إلى إن أو إحدى أخواتها
ism_inna_needs_inna.en: The اسم إن needs إن or one of its sisters before it.

follower_needs_noun.en: A follower (معطوف, توكيد, صفة, بدل) copies a noun that comes before it, and none was found.

tamyeez_needs_number.ar: منصوب: حال أو تمييز أو مفعول لأجله
tamyeez_needs_number.en: Accusative. It could be a حال, تمييز or مفعول لأجله, and I can't tell which. A تمييز follows a number or a measure.
